shared.name: Name
shared.dueHint: Empty: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after sending.

view.payToWithNumber: Pay to account {account} and mark the payment with invoice number {number}.

usage.intro: What the call centres have used of paid services, and what it costs us.
usage.sonioxNote: {transcriptions} transcriptions, {asyncHours} h audio, {realtimeHours} h real time
usage.byCentreNote: Amounts in kroner at today's rate, including eID. Transcriptions are calls, however many times they have been processed.

service.soniox_async_hour: Soniox, per hour of audio (after the call)
service.soniox_realtime_hour: Soniox, per hour of audio (real time)

usage.noRates: No rate fetched yet. It is fetched every morning.

stripe.intro: Subscriptions paid by card through Stripe.
stripe.body: Once the Stripe account and keys are in place, the subscribers will appear here (alongside the invoice customers), the prices with MRR, and tools to link a call centre to a package, pause, change plan, give discounts and refund. The packages under Invoicing will then be linked to Stripe prices.

invoices.intro: A sent invoice gets the next number and cannot be changed. Mistakes are corrected with a credit note.
invoices.issueHint: A future date schedules sending for that morning.
invoices.grantAccess: Grant access: the call centre is open for the period (from the invoice date, as many days as the month has), and the packages' modules are switched on

invoice.issueHint: Today sends it now. A future date schedules sending for that morning.
invoice.grantAccess: Grant the call centre access for the period, and switch on the packages' modules
invoice.periodToHint: Empty: as many days as the month has.
invoice.confirmSchedule: Schedule sending for {date}? It will be sent automatically that morning.
invoice.confirmSend: Send the invoice now? It gets the next invoice number, is sent by email and cannot be changed afterwards.
invoice.sentNoEmail: Sent. It was not sent by email (email is not set up, or the call centre has no invoice email). Download the PDF and send it yourself.
invoice.usageMonthHint: Hours of audio and AI controls, at the prices under Settings.
invoice.missed: Payment missed {time}. The call centre is closed and the fixed agreements are paused. Register the payment to reopen; the agreements continue from the next due date.
invoice.noEmail: The call centre had no invoice email when the invoice was sent. Download the PDF and send it yourself.
invoice.confirmMissed: Mark the payment as missed? The call centre is closed immediately, and the fixed agreements are paused.
invoice.confirmCredit: Create a credit note for the whole invoice? It gets the next invoice number and is sent by email.

customers.intro: The customers are the call centres. The customer number is fixed. Invoice email and address are changed under Call centres.
customers.accessPrompt: Access for {name} up to and including date (YYYY-MM-DD), or empty to stop the invoices controlling access:

recurring.confirmRun: Run the morning job now? Scheduled invoices and fixed agreements due to go out today will be sent by email.
recurring.nothing: Nothing was due to be sent today.
recurring.intro: Fixed agreements are sent automatically every morning, a set number of days before the due date. Scheduled invoices are sent on the morning of the invoice date.
recurring.confirmResume: Resume without the payment being registered? The next invoice will be sent as usual.
recurring.nameHint: Shown as a note on the invoice.
recurring.nextDueHint: The due date repeats on the same day each period. If the date is changed, the periods are counted from the new one.
recurring.daysBeforeHint: When the invoice is sent. Empty: default ({days}).
recurring.grantAccess: Grant access: each invoice keeps the call centre open for the period and switches on the packages' modules
recurring.confirmDelete: Delete the recurring invoice? Invoices already sent remain.

packages.intro: The packages the call centres buy. A package on an invoice with access switches on the modules in the package.
packages.priceHint: A changed price applies to new invoices; sent ones are not changed.
packages.activeHint: Active (can be chosen on new invoices)

settings.intro: Sender, payment terms and prices. Sent invoices keep the details they were sent with.
settings.vatRegistered: Registered in the Norwegian VAT Register (the invoices include VAT)
settings.recurringDaysBefore: Recurring: sent days before due date
settings.nextNumberHint: Can only be set higher than the last number used.
settings.emailEnabled: Invoices are emailed from noreply@ with a PDF when they are sent.
settings.emailDisabled: Email is not set up yet (see docs/plan.md, section 17). Until then, the PDF is downloaded and sent by hand.
settings.copyEmailHint: Blind copy, for example to the accountants. Optional.
settings.priceAudioHour: Price per hour of audio (excl. VAT)
settings.priceAudioHourHint: Empty: transcription is not invoiced as usage.
settings.priceAiControlHint: Empty: AI control is not invoiced as usage.
settings.logoType: The logo must be PNG or JPEG.
settings.logoSize: The logo can be up to 500 kB.
settings.confirmRemoveLogo: Remove the logo from the invoices?
settings.noLogo: No logo. The invoice shows the company name instead.

accounting.intro: Revenue is counted when the money comes in. VAT is kept out of turnover. Stripe will follow once it is connected.
accounting.subscriptionsNote: {paying} call centres with paid access, {trials} on trial
accounting.amountHint: Negative amount for a credit or refund.
accounting.confirmDeleteFixed: Delete the fixed expense? It also disappears from previous months.
